notes: Numbers come from Microsoft's own Surface Duo 2 Fact Sheet (October 2021) hosted on news.microsoft.com - primary. The microsoft.com/en-us/surface/devices/surface-duo-2 retail spec page is gone; the live support.microsoft.com 'Surface Duo 2 features' page is a feature overview and carries NO spec table, so the fact sheet was used instead. Microsoft states the combined open display as 'Dual PixelSense™ Fusion Displays open: 8.3” AMOLED, 2688x1892' - that is the two 5.8" panels side by side (1344x1892 each x2), so it is NOT recorded as a third physical display. Microsoft writes 'AMOLED'; recorded as OLED per the SPEC enum. Microsoft states 401 PPI, HDR, 100% sRGB / DCI-P3 and 800 nits max brightness. resolution_px preserves Microsoft's own ordering. Aspect ratio is not stated by Microsoft for Duo 2 - null. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: the fact sheet says only 'Revolutionary Hinge' and names Book/Compose/Tent modes, it does not restate 360° for this model. ports left [] on purpose: the fact sheet lists no port row - it mentions USB-C only in the context of the separately sold 'Microsoft Surface 23W USB-C Power Supply', which states the charger, not the device connector. Battery 4449mAh (typical) dual battery. announced date is the Microsoft event page title for the launch event at which Surface Duo 2 was introduced. hinge.axis is NULL on purpose: no manufacturer page states a hinge/fold axis. It is unambiguous from the OEM's own dimension rows (the height stays constant while the width changes between states, so the hinge line runs along the long edge), but deriving it would breach the SPEC rule that active_area_mm is the only derived field.
